text: わたしに　ついて　きなさい！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a verb followed by くる says the action is done while coming along. ついて　きなさい = 'come along following (me)'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい on the end of a verb is a firm order, the kind a parent or teacher gives. きなさい = 'come!'.
